steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Don't go... don't leave...</color>
The toy bear has been defeated, but its contamination residues still stand in your way, moaning eerily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's over. Time to go out and face reality.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>But the mirage is clearly so much better...</color>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Reality always leads to pain!</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're using the same trick again. Aren't you tired of it?
You wave away the dark mist in front of you, but it gathers again into another shadow.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Why can't everything just remain in this moment forever?

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Isn't it wonderful to stay in a world without any worries?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's fake will always be fake. They cannot bring about genuine feelings.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>But those people you brought back to reality... did they really... find happiness?</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least we should give Eve the right to see the truth and make her own choice.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Ha, how do you know that Eve...</color>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>...hasn't made a choice?</color>

The black smoke laughs menacingly as it pounces on you. You block it instinctively. The sharp spikes of your shackles tear open the last bit of contamination, revealing a memory you've never seen before.
In this memory, Eve is carefully hugging a pile of rags, her face clearly tear-streaked.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: These are the things left by Mr. Benna before he passed away. I'm sorry. There was a severe Mania incident. These were all I could find.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Male
steps.content: Mania? My God, is there any contamination on these?!

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Male
steps.content: Why are you giving us that old man's stuff?! It's bad luck!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Don't say that. Mr. Benna cares a lot about his granddaughter Shanna.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Female
steps.content: Granddaughter? He doesn't have a granddaughter! He's just an old bachelor who makes up different stories every day.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Male
steps.content: Exactly! His memory gets worse every year. We've been trying to avoid him for ages. Thank goodness he actually found a job and left! You got scammed, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Aren't you his son and daughter-in-law?

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Female
steps.content: You must be mistaken. We really don't know this Benna, and there's no Shanna here. Miss, you better leave.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Male
steps.content: And take these things with you... Hey, did you also just come out of that factory? Is there contamination on you too?!

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Male
steps.content: Stay back! If you come over, I'll call the sheriff!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bass said he made a lot of friends here.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: He passed away unexpectedly. I wanted to visit on his behalf.

steps.speaker: Orphanage Director
steps.content: Bass... Bass who?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Don't you remember? A very tall, loud and strong young man.
The orphanage director scratches his head and stops a colleague passing by.

steps.speaker: Orphanage Director
steps.content: Hey, do you remember if we had someone like that?

steps.speaker: Orphanage Staff
steps.content: Let me think... a loud voice? Ah, are you talking about that buffoon?

steps.speaker: Orphanage Staff
steps.content: Bass... so that's his name!

steps.speaker: Orphanage Director
steps.content: Did he have any friends?

steps.speaker: Orphanage Staff
steps.content: Would someone so dumb even know what the word 'friend' means?

steps.speaker: Orphanage Staff
steps.content: Maybe he thinks those who spat at him from upstairs are his friends!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It seems that no one remembers him... Eh, miss?

steps.speaker: Orphanage Staff
steps.content: Where did she go? She moves pretty fast for someone in a wheelchair.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Kids go missing every day. Where do you expect us to find a kid who's been missing for over ten years?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Get out of here. Don't interfere with our work.

Eve gets pushed out helplessly by the sheriff. The missing person notices that Maresa gave her get scattered all over the ground. Biting her lip, Eve bends over to try to pick them up, but her fingers are always an inch short of the ground.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Maybe to you, he's just one of thousands of missing children, but he's Maresa's only child...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: What are you mumbling about? Pack up your stuff and leave. Don't come back. We can't help you.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Polly really left nothing behind?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yeah, she left nothing. Everything was destroyed in that disaster.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Isn't there compensation from the factory? How can she just die on us like that! Does that good-for-nothing girl want her little brother to starve?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Little brother?

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Ah, I mean... Miss Eve, you can see that we're struggling to make ends meet. You are, after all, the daughter of the factory boss. Maybe you can...

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Wh-why are you glaring at me like that...

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Okay, forget the compensation then... No need to be so hostile...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bone, I'm throwing you your last birthday party.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Actually, this birthday party shouldn't exist either, but I promised to take you for a walk. I'm afraid I can't fulfill that promise now.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I always feel like I owe you something. Let me make it up to you with a birthday party. You won't blame me, will you?
Eve stares intently at the flame in her hand, watching it move slowly down the wooden stick, burning all the way to her fingertips.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The bear... the fire... it must be a mess outside. But luckily, things didn't get worse.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm sorry, ${PlayerName}. I must've caused you a lot of trouble.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Apart from my family members, you are truly the nicest person I've ever met.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You didn't abandon me, nor did you deceive me for ulterior motives.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The future you offered is so beautiful. I was almost convinced.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But then I remembered, I've heard about such a beautiful future many, many times...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm sorry I didn't tell you.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I've already secretly gone to see the world outside the factory.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Turns out, it's all fake, even faker than the toy families pretending to be real. Turns out...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: ...everyone is a liar.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Loyal friends, loving family members, the kindness of the world... none of these exist outside.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Maybe I really could meet new people and start a new life.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's strange. As opposed to those small "possibilities" that haven't happened yet, I prefer the old, prefer to stay in place, prefer liars...
Eve withdraws all her Mania power. In the sea of fire in the warehouse, toys fall one by one from the giant bear and disperse to finally reveal the girl beneath the monster.
With her back turned to you, she is struggling to maneuver her wheelchair into the depths of the fire.
You recall what Eureka said about how to resolve the crisis in the simplest way: if the creator is gone, her wish and creations will all disappear.
Amidst the raging fire, your mouth is dry and your voice is hoarse, making it hard to speak.
But you still drag your heavy feet, trying to walk through the chaotic warehouse in fire and get closer to Eve.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait... hold on! There must be another way...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Things are fine the way they are now.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's swallowing my obsession of staying here forever. I can't let go of this obsession, but I can let go of myself.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: This is fine. This way, everyone can escape. You have friends, family, hopes, and a future too, right? Go find them, I'm fine. After all, I never really had anything...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: This time, I can truly reunite with my family.
The fire is spreading faster than Mania. In an instant, a wave of heat forms an invisible barrier between you two.
The silhouette in the fire doesn't look back. She stares at the ceiling, lit red by the fire, and cheerily hums a tune.
Rescue seems to have arrived. The shouts of the rescuers and those fleeing drown out Eve's voice. You try but fail to make out what Eve is humming.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be another way to resolve this Mania crisis! Just come out with me first!
As the flames inch closer, spreading to Eve's skirt and hair, she remains motionless.
That figure keeps repeating an answer you've never anticipated...
She doesn't want to leave, not just out of nostalgia, but also because she's seen the outside world.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's been a long time since someone cared about me and talked to me this much.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You should be careful, too. The fire is hot. When it burns you... it hurts.
She parks her wheelchair in the deepest spot of the warehouse and leans back in exhaustion.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Please tell your friend... that I thank her for liking my toys...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But I won't be making toys anymore.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: This time, we can truly stay together...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm going home.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... Eve!!!

The fire completely engulfs the surroundings, and you can no longer see Eve. In the scorching, twisted air, you seem to see familiar toys jump into the sea of fire together: a screaming chicken, a rubber ball, a puppy, a doll, a nesting doll...
All the anomalies created by Eve have already been reversed. Then those who just jumped into the sea of fire were... You want to shout something, but a fiery wave rushes into your mouth and nose.
Amidst the sound of burnt shelves falling over, the stubborn ruin of the Buonanotte Factory finally collapses into the fire. Now, you finally hear the soft humming clearly.
Sleep, Eve...
Tomorrow is another day...
Good night...
Buonanotte.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the injured are being accounted for and treated one by one.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The fire was quite intense. Right now... we still haven't found the Sinners you mentioned.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You found neither Eve nor Oliver?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No. We can only continue the search after the disaster is under control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right... Have you been up all night and waiting outside the factory?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I firmly believed that Chief would come out safely.
Having inhaled some smoke, you are currently resting on a rock outside the factory. The sky outside has become vividly bright by now.

In front of you, the victims of this accident are being transported away one by one on stretchers. They are digesting the chaotic time difference and information in fear and confusion. Of course, there are also a few who are particularly excited.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: See! I told you that Pepper is the biggest badass in DisCity!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: I really made a big hullabaloo this time! I brought so many people out!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: They were scared to death when they saw that Pepper and Eureka were both Sinners!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief, Chief! Aside from the factory, I found another fun place! Wanna go next time? Let's go together! Please, please~
The blonde girl is energetically waving her hands from the stretcher.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Pepper says she's fine, but it's better to have her checked out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you. You've protected her well.
Shaking her head with a smile, her gaze follows Pepper as she gets loaded onto the ambulance.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we can leave the rest to the fire crew and rescue team. The 9th Agency is waiting for your report on this incident. We should go back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay.
You take another look at the factory. The fire shows no signs of diminishing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's go.

You get up and dust yourself off. The solid touch reminds you once again that you're no longer a rag doll. So many things have happened in this one night. You feel a bit dazed as you get in the car and leave with Nightingale and Eureka.

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: How wonderful it would have been if everyone turned into toys. Victory was in sight. Yet the worst choice was made.

The smoke from the factory blankets the sky above the Rust for a long, long time. It is said to be the most stubborn fire ever faced by DisCity's fire department. In the end, it finally got extinguished by a sudden downpour.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Pretty lady, Oliver just escaped from a terrible fire and is now penniless... can you take me in?

Despite all the commotion, neither Eastside nor Syndicate pays any attention. The story of Eve's toy factory is just another stone thrown into the sea. It makes no splash, no sound, and sinks to the bottom of the sea just like countless other stones.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Hey! Come here, there's someone under this slab!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: It's a girl... She seems to be alive!
